description.value: The study compares frontal and broader brain activation and activation changes with working-memory load in patients with early frontotemporal dementia and early Alzheimer disease using fMRI.

spans.text: To compare frontal cortex activation in patients with early frontotemporal dementia (FTD) with that in patients with early AD.

instructions.value: In the fixation condition, fixate on a cross. In the target=X condition, press the button when the letter X appears. In the 1-back condition, press the button when a letter is directly repeated. In the 2-back condition, press the button when a letter is repeated with one other letter in between.

spans.text: During FIX, patients had to fixate on a cross presented every 2 seconds. During X, patients had to press the button when the letter X appeared; during simple working memory, they had to press the button when a letter was directly repeated (for example, A A); and during increased working memory load, they had to press the button when a letter was repeated with one other letter in between (A B A).

stimuli.value: Letters presented visually every 2 seconds, with each letter shown for 1.5 seconds followed by a 0.5-second black screen; fixation cross during the FIX condition.
